summary: Modular monolith architecture combining React (Vite) frontend and ASP.NET Core (.NET 8) backend with Microsoft SQL Server hosted on Azure App Service. Estimated monthly infrastructure cost ranges from $55 to $205.

frontend.justification: Lightweight client-rendered SPA provides rapid interactive state management with minimal framework overhead.

alternatives.why_not: Server-side rendering runtime unnecessary for authenticated, non-SEO internal/SaaS app.

tradeoffs: Initial bundle download before client hydration.

backend.justification: High-throughput compiled backend offering first-class integration with Microsoft Entra ID and SQL Server.

alternatives.why_not: Lacks native enterprise integration with existing Microsoft 365 and on-prem SQL Server infrastructure.

tradeoffs: Tighter coupling with Microsoft developer ecosystem.

database.justification: Direct integration with existing on-premise SQL Server 2019 and Azure SQL ecosystem, preserving existing data schemas.

alternatives.why_not: Migrating existing enterprise SQL Server data and stored procedures adds significant project risk.

tradeoffs: Commercial licensing costs if scaled to dedicated instances.

hosting.justification: Managed PaaS deployment in Azure Central India (Pune) with automated OS patching and native Entra ID authentication integration.

alternatives.why_not: Incompatible with explicit cloud preference for Azure and lacks native Entra ID managed identity hooks.

tradeoffs: Higher compute plan cost when scaling to premium dedicated hardware.

supporting.justification: Durable, encrypted cloud object storage for user document and photo uploads with presigned URL access.

alternatives.why_not: Local container disks are ephemeral and lose user uploads on container restarts.

tradeoffs: Outbound internet data egress transfer costs.

supporting.justification: Authentication service resolving enterprise_sso requirements with secure token issuance.

alternatives.why_not: Auth0 adds high per-user enterprise tier pricing, whereas Entra ID natively links with existing corporate M365 directories.

assumptions: Estimates based on published cloud pricing units and standard resource allocations.
